items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: On one of these--I can't see where it is now--I saw Effie Smith's name, and uh, then I also saw the name J. Lawrence Criner. Is that...

ctx.x: I never did see him after that...after...he was with us in the record company and everything else and... He and Austin and I were the three in it, you know, and finally, he went home one night, and his father, I think he died right in his arms, and he come back, and he...he pulled out.
